import java.util.*

fun main() {
    val sc = Scanner(System.`in`)
    val a = sc.nextLong()
    val b = sc.nextLong()
    val p = sc.nextInt()
    val x = sc.nextLong()

    var count = 0L
    var current = 1L
    for (n in 1..p) {
        if (n > x) break
        if (current == b) {
            val maxN = x
            val period = p.toLong()
            val first = n.toLong()
            if (first > maxN) continue
            val terms = (maxN - first) / period + 1
            count += terms
        }
        current = (current * a) % p
    }
    println(count)
}
```

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.math.BigInteger

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val (a, b, p, x) = br.readLine().split(" ").map { it.toLong() }
    val pp = p.toInt()
    var count = 0L
    val period = pp - 1
    val aBig = BigInteger.valueOf(a)
    val bBig = BigInteger.valueOf(b)
    val pBig = BigInteger.valueOf(p)
    for (r in 0 until period) {
        val n = r + 1
        if (n > x) break
        val an = aBig.modPow(BigInteger.valueOf(n.toLong()), pBig)
        val lhs = an.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(n.toLong())).mod(pBig)
        if (lhs == bBig) {
            val kMax = (x - r) / period
            count += kMax + 1
        }
    }
    println(count)
}
```
